༁ྃ::gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor las bde chen zhing gi sgrub thabs 'don cha bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: :gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor las bde chen zhing gi sgrub thabs 'don cha bzhugs so//

gu ru dhe wa dhākki ni: 'od dpag med pa bsgrub pa ni: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu bskyed do: ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rakta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū dza ho: me tog chu skyes padma'i steng : de nang rang nyid sems dpa' dkar: mdun du padma zla gdan la: 'od dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag steng : lhung bzed 'dzin cing chos gos gsol: skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa la: g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang : g.yas g.yon phreng ba padma 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis pad zlar bzhugs: g.yon du phyag rdor mthu chen thob: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo: g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis pad zlar bzhugs: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang : nyan thos dgra bcom dpag med bskor: gtso bo gsum gyi gnas gsum gyi: 'bru gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: bde ba can nas spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐ 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs ma lus rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsol: skal ldan dad ldan bdag la dbang mchog bskur: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad bsal du gsol: sna tshogs padma zla ba'i gdan steng du: 'od dpag med kyi lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐ bde chen zhing du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: sems can rnams la rtag tu thugs rjes gzigs: dam bca' zhal bzhes 'gro ba'i skyabs mdzad pa: snang mtha' mnyam bzhag mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ āḥmi dhe wa hrīḥ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣṭha lhan: a ti pu ho: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs nas: dbang bskur tshe dpag dbu brgyan gyur:

hūm̐ bdag gis dri ldan dri chab kyis: 'od dpag sku la khrus gsol lo: lha la dri ma mi mnga' yang : sdig sgrib dag pa'i rten 'brel bgyi: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: hūm̐ ras dkar 'jam dri ldan pa yis: 'od dpag sku nyid phyi bar bgyi: sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang : sdug bsngal bral ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: hūm̐ na bza' mdzes ldan ngur smrig 'di: rgyal ba'i sku la gsol bar bgyi: sku la bsil ba mi mnga' yang : bkrag mdangs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: hūm̐ rin chen rgyan cha mdzes pa 'di: rgyal sras nyid kyi sku la gsol: sku la rgyan gsol mi mnga' yang : gzi brjid che ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: hūm̐ yan lag brgyad ldan zhal bsil 'di: rgyal ba sras bcas zhal du 'bul: zhal la skyems pa mi mnga' yang : sdug bsngal bral ba'i rten 'brel bgyi: hūm̐ 'od dpag zhabs dri dag bya'i phyir: zhabs bsil dri ldan 'di 'bul na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyis zhabs bsil ser mor bskyed: zhabs la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐ 'od dpag spyan gzigs rgyas pa'i phyir: me tog mdzes pa 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyis puṣpe dkar mor bskyed: spyan la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐ 'od dpag shangs mchog dgyes pa'i phyir: dri zhim bdug spos 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyis dhū pe sngon mor bskyed: shangs la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐ 'od dpag phyag mchog rgyas pa'i phyir: mar me gsal ba 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyis dhī paṃ dmar mor bskyed: phyag la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐ 'od dpag sku lus bkrag rgyas phyir: dri chab dri ldan 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyis gandhe ljang mor bskyed: sku la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐ 'od dpag sku bkrag 'don pa'i phyir:

zhal zas ro mchog 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyis nai wi dye ser mor bskyed: ljags la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐ 'od dpag snyan mchog rgyas pa'i phyir: rol mo snyan la 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyis shapta ser mor bskyed: snyan la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐ tshe dpag sku nyid rgyas pa'i phyir: rig ma rgyan ldan 'di 'bul na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyis rig ma mdzes par bskyed: sku la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pādyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shapta mu dra āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bkris gtso bo rdzas brgyad de: gtso mchog rgyal po yungs kar sogs: bdag gis lha la mchod pa 'bul: tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par shog: maṅga laṃ artha siddhi hūṃ: hūm̐ bkris gtso bo rtags brgyad de: gtso mchog rgyal po bum pa sogs: bdag gis lha la mchod pa 'bul: sems can tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: maṅga laṃ kumbha hūṃ: hūm̐ 'dod yon rtsa ba rin chen bdun: gtso mchog rgyal po nor bu sogs: bdag gis lha la mchod pa 'bul: bdag ni tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: oṃ ma ṇi ratna hūṃ: hūm̐ kun gyi gtso bor ri rab gling : ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bcas: bdag gis lha la mchod pa 'bul: tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par shog: oṃ ratna maṇḍa la hūm̐: hūm̐ bdag gis skyabs gnas tshe dpag la: bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyi bdud rtsi'i lha mor bskyed: tshe dpag khyed la 'bul ba na: thugs rjes bdag gzhan thams cad la: mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐ bdag gis skyabs gnas 'od dpag la: gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyi 'dod yon lha mor bskyed: 'od dpag khyed la 'bul ba na: thugs rjes bdag gzhan thams cad la: mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol:

hūm̐ bdag gis skyabs gnas 'od dpag la: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul ba na: bdag ni tha mal lus po yang : sems kyi mchod pa'i lha mor bskyed: 'od dpag khyed la 'bul ba na: thugs rjes bdag gzhan thams cad la: mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badzra pañtsa a mṛ ta bha ling ta rakta kha raṃ khā hi: oṃ rdo rje'i sku ni sku yi mchog: tshangs dang brgya byin 'gran du med: nam mkha' lta bu'i sku mnga' ba'i: chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: āḥrdo rje'i gsung ni gsung gi mchog: che ba 'brug gis do zla med: snyan pa glu mas do zla med: thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa yi: longs spyod rdzogs skur phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ rdo rje'i thugs ni thugs kyi mchog: 'gro ba'i don la nges par gzigs: tshangs pa brgya byin thugs kyis kyang : do zla med pa'i bka' drin can: sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur pas: 'od dpag thugs dang gang 'gal ba: bshags bgyi badzra sa twa hūm̐: oṃ sku yi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: khyed kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: āḥgasung gi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: khyed kyi gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: khyed kyi thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ hrīḥswā hā: badzra sa twa oṃ: badzra sa twa āḥ badzra sa twa hūm̐: e ma ho: ngo mtshar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang : thugs rje chen po mthu chen thob la sogs: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med thams cad la: rtse gcig gus pa'i sems kyis gsol ba 'debs: bdag la mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: snang ba mtha' yas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas rtsa sngags 'bring po ni: oṃ ā mi dhe wa hrīḥ yang bsdus hrīḥbasgrang chog pa yin: de nas tshe 'gugs tshe sgrub ni: hūm̐ bcom ldan 'od dpag med mgon ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag lhung bzed bsnams:

zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: sprul pa'i lha mo mgyogs ma lngas: tshe bum 'dzin cing mda' dar g.yab: 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus lhung bzed thim: lhung bzed tshe yi bdud rtsis bskangs: de nas rang la thim par gyur: hūm̐ mda' dar shar du g.yug pa'i tshe: rlung gi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon ljang gu'i 'od du 'bar: de dbus rlung gi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar ljang : bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: ljang 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar lho ru g.yugs pa'i tshe: me yi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon dmar po 'od du 'bar: de dbus me yi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar dmar: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: dmar 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar nub tu g.yugs pa'i tshe: lcags kyi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon dkar po 'od du 'bar: de dbus lcags kyi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar dkar: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: dkar 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar byang du g.yugs pa'i tshe: chu yi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon sngon po 'od du 'bar: de dbus chu yi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar sngo: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: sngo 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar steng du g.yugs pa'i tshe: sa yi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon ser po 'od du 'bar: de dbus sa yi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdar dar ser: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: ser 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi bkrag bsdus la: bdag gi bkrag mdangs rgyas par mdzod: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi tshe bsdus la: bdag gi tshe 'di brtan par mdzod: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi bcud bsdus la: bdag gi tshe bcud rgyas par mdzod:

phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi 'od bsdus la: bdag gi 'od ni rgyas par mdzod: tadya thā: ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa: ma ma ā yuḥsiddhi pha la puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: e ma ho: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang : thugs rje chen po mthu chen thob dang ni: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med rnams la: bdag gis gus pa'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol: dang po rtsa sngags rgyas pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mi dhe wa ā yu siddhi hūṃ: oṃ bhrūṃ swā hā: bhrūṃ gnyis ni: gang 'dod gcig ni bzlas pas chog: de nas mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das: 'od du zhu nas rang la thim: rang lus nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar: bcom ldan 'das kyi skur snang ba: gsal stong zung du 'jug par gyur: e ma ho: ngo mtshar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang : g.yas su jo bo thugs rje chen po dang : g.yon du sems dpa' mthu chen thob rnams la: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med 'khor gyis bskor: bde skyid ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa yi: bde ba can zhes bya ba'i zhing khams der: bdag ni 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ru: de ru skyes nas snang mtha'i zhal mthong shog: de skad bdag gis smon lam btab pa 'di: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis: gegs med 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tadya thā: pañtsa dri ya a wa bo dha nā ye swā hā: bde chen zhing sgrub 'don cha 'di: gter blon rā ga a sye yis: gter ston dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir: gnam chos gzhung nas btus te bsgrigs: nye gnas kun dgas yi ger bkod: nyes 'gal mchis na lha la bshags: dge bas 'brel thog 'gro ba kun: bde chen zhing du skye phyir bsngo: : gnam chos 'od chog bsngo ba ni: phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs: tshogs gnyis rdzogs la rjes yi rang :

bdag gis dus gsum dge bsags pa: dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul: rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel gyur cig: dge ba sems can kun la bsngo: 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob gyur cig: dge rtsa thams cad gcig bsdus te: bdag gi rgyud la smin gyur cig: sgrib gnyis dag nas tshogs rdzogs te: tshe ring nad med nyams rtogs 'phel: tshe 'dir sa bcu non gyur cig: nam zhig tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: bde ba can du skye gyur cig: skyes nas padma'i kha phye ste: lus rten de la sangs rgyas shog: byang chub thob nas ji srid du: sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren par shog: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: ces sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum bya lo chu stod zla ba'i tshes gcig la snang ba mtha' yas kyi bka' stsal pa'o: ༈ smon lam sogs ji tsam bton rjes su: thal mo sbyar la: oṃ 'grub par gyur cig rdo rje'i sku ni skye 'chi bral: tshangs pa'i gsung ni skye med rtag pa rdo rje'i gsung : spros bral thugs ni dus gsum 'gyur med rdo rje'i thugs: 'chi med sku gsung thugs dang yang dag ldan pa yi: rnga sgra'i rgyal po 'dren pa 'od dpag med: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las 'grub gyur te: bdag cag tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: rlabs chen 'gro ba'i don la spyod par shog: zhes lan gsum brjod par bya ste rdo rje'i tshig go /de nas bzod gsol/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs yig brgya brjod nas gzhung gi / de nas mdun gyi sogs bsdu rim dang : shis brjod dge bsngo sogs bya'o/// /dge legs 'phel//
